title: no-redundant-condition-after-empty-mixed (clean-room semantics)

ground_truth.statement: An initially empty mixed value can become truthy in the loop. The repeated empty test is not constant across iterations.

allowed.reason: The explicitly mixed list elements cannot give the assigned variable a more precise type. This documented precision warning is independent of loop reachability. https://psalm.dev/docs/running_psalm/issues/MixedAssignment/

notes: The local source is a lead, not an oracle. Fixture and deterministic controls are re-derived from PHP semantics.
